286269.name: Chabad of the Tri - Valley
286269.note: The center's own About page: 'in 2005 Rabbi Raleigh Resnick and his wife Fruma founded Chabad of The Tri-Valley'; Pleasanton Weekly (June 2025): founded 'out of their home in 2005'; Danville San Ramon (2023): the Resnicks 'arrived in Pleasanton in 2005'.

118515.name: Chabad of the North Peninsula
118515.note: Lubavitch.com: 'In 2001, he [Rabbi Yossi Marcus] and his wife Esty moved to S. Mateo ... and established Chabad of the North Peninsula'; J. (Oct 2022, https://jweekly.com/2022/10/19/20m-chabad-center-opens-in-san-mateo-elk-grove-welcomes-first-chabad/): they 'started Chabad of the North Peninsula out of an apartment in 2001'. Its $20 million center in San Mateo opened in Oct 2022 (J.).

earlier.where: an apartment, where the Marcuses started it

117568.name: Chabad Center of University City
117568.note: The center's own About page: 'Our synagogue began in 1978 as Chabad of La Jolla, when a small group of devoted individuals gathered in a private home'; Rabbi Moishe Leider its rabbi from 1986.

earlier.where: a private home (as Chabad of La Jolla)

299072.name: Chabad Jewish Center of Laguna Niguel
299072.note: The center's own 'Our Story': 'In the fall of 2005, Chabad of Laguna Niguel began in a humble living room'; Patch and Lubavitch.com: the center opened its doors in January 2006 (Rabbi Mendy and Kreinie Paltiel).

767122.name: The Rohr Chabad at UC Irvine
767122.note: Orange County Register, Sept 26 2009 ('New UCI Chabad observes Yom Kippur'): 'Rabbi Zev Tenenbaum's new Chabad at UC Irvine ... prepares for the group's first Yom Kippur on campus. Rabbi and Miriam Tenenbaum, who arrived at UCI eight months ago' (about Jan 2009), opening 'their home adjacent to campus'. Found by Firecrawl's research agent; the quote checked.

earlier.where: the Tenenbaums' home next to campus

120014.name: Desert Torah Academy-Bais Menachem
120014.note: The school's own history: 'Desert Torah Academy began in 1994 with five students learning in a family's living room' / 'was founded in 1994'. The Chinuch Office directory (2023-24) gives 'Founded: 1999' (perhaps when it became a full day school), so medium. Checked (Nov 6): the school's own history is the second source; it disagrees with the directory. At 1312 Vista Dr., Las Vegas, in the Chinuch Office's 2012-13 and 2023-24 directories.

earlier.where: a family's living room, Las Vegas (five students)

7184219.name: The Cheder of the Bay Area
7184219.note: No year found; three that disagree: the Chinuch Office directory (2023-24) gives the Cheder of the Bay Area 'Founded: 2007' (perhaps Tri-Valley's school program); a Facebook post seems to say 2014; Anash.org (Mar 2024) says it 'began as a small co-op, an alternative to online school' and opened 'just a few years ago'. Same dot as Chabad of the Tri-Valley (2005). At 6668 Owens Dr. in the Chinuch Office's 2023-24 directory; its listing now gives 3370 Hopyard Road, Pleasanton.
